mapping.sheet: Measured1.6mm becomes default upright grip thickness; expose1.6–2.0. Tool backing redesigned2–2.6mm.
mapping.interface: Preserve4.5mm source nominal socket width as grip tongue breadth. Receiving mortise is4.5+fit by sheet+fit. Measured source allowance .100012; new TOTAL allowance .15mm default,.1–.3 proposed,not universal.
mapping.runners: Source low runners .21/.22; original Boolean carrier has8 accessible runners .4–.6 thick,.8–1.4 wide. Four tool landings on LEFT non-datum edge;4 grip landings avoid tongue.
mapping.geometry: Original tomahawk reconstruction E=(-2R,0),D=(-R,0),C=(0,0),semicircle y<=0;RIGHT handle datum x=-R with handle material to its left. Upright grip lowers vertically into mortise.

newDesign.interaction: Neusis simultaneous datum/vertex,spike/ray and arc/tangent alignment trisects an angle. Mark C,remove tool,join to vertex with straightedge.
newDesign.math: h=R/tan(theta/3);CD=DE=R;AD perpendicular ED. Three congruent right triangles. Semicircle96 chords,sagitta<=.003481mm for R<=26.
newDesign.parameters: R18–26,handle72–96,palm18–22,gripheight14–20,breadth12–16,all mm. Three handle profiles preserve datum.
newDesign.retention: ONE bonded fixed clearance joint;no physical friction/snap-fit claim.
newDesign.art: 13mm diameter safe lower handle zone centred(-R-palm/2,-handle+12),depth.4–.6,>=1.4mm backing. Away from datum,arc,spike,slot and calibration ticks.
newDesign.differentFromPrior: Unique tomahawk neusis angle-trisection geometry and fixed upright handling grip,not earlier compass,caliper,ellipse,trammel or brush rack. Reuses local studio/import/export infrastructure,not their mechanisms.

sourceDefects: Reference nonwatertight;27 edge-adjacent components. Used only as measured design reference,not repaired or re-exported.
